cells.note: The latest figure, 14.4 per cent for 2023 from ITU's series, is 20 or less but above 10, so 3 and not 4. Afrobarometer's 2024 survey (33 per cent of men, 18 of women online a few times a month) is an opinion survey with its own definition, not a household ICT survey, and is not staged.
